plain_description.what: A one-time random draw with no model calls. Using a pre-registered seed, it picked which 7 of the 14 MMLU-Pro subject areas form stage 1 of the new (v2) architecture, stratified by size. It was redone on the new data split.
plain_description.why: It fixes the stage-1 subjects in advance and at random, so that later results cannot come from choosing subjects after seeing the data.
plain_description.information: It produces a fixed, auditable list of subjects. A mismatch with the reviewer's independent prediction would have voided the draw. Result: done. The subjects are chemistry, computer science, economics, health, math, other and philosophy. They match the reviewer's prediction. This draw replaces the first draw for future use. It says nothing about stage-1 results.
